{npc:Norman The Foreman}, foreman of the construction works in the swamp east of Venore, always needs an extra hand. He has three daily tasks — **Maintenance** (oiling machines), **Pathfinder** (delivering supplies) and **Sabotage** (killing corym rats) — that give experience and gold. If you do all three in under 20 hours you also get a bonus: 1000 XP and 1000 gp per day in total.
Norman The Foreman, central construction site east of Venore
